title: Infinity Sports Launches Women’s High-Performance Program
body: Infinity Sports introduced a dedicated high-performance pathway for women’s basketball and volleyball, featuring new scholarships and international friendly tours.
author: Media Team

title: Padel Complex Certified for International Events
body: The Infinity Padel Complex received full certification for international ranking events, making it the first venue of its kind in Jordan.
author: Coaching Staff

title: Finance Team Rolls Out Cashless Petty Cash Workflow
body: Infinity Sports accounting has moved all petty cash requests and reimbursement workflows to the portal with instant approvals and digital receipts.
author: Finance Office
